features.justification_quote: optimizing for breakdown behaviors in a specific model family crosses into harmful territory

features.quote: Avoid malicious ambiguity. Don't use tasks designed to confuse the model into pathological states.
Avoid optimizing for 'breaking the model.' You want to expose weaknesses in the platform, not to make the model fail more often than a real adversary would.
Set per-task caps: wall-clock limit, token budget, tool-call budget, max edit iterations, max failed test cycles before forced stop
